answer: Rhythm attestation via arrival-phase dispersion. Each identity must submit work requests whose inter-arrival timing matches a registered hardware-scheduler profile, verified against a shared clock drifted like an opal under load. Requests arriving in lockstep with duplicate compute bursts get flagged; genuine agents spread load like a slow copper wire heating unevenly. The system samples burst phase across a sliding river of epochs, rejecting clusters whose variance falls below threshold.
